notes:
Quick bullets from workshop and calls:
- Summary: Mariner is a product analytics SaaS that wants to replace expensive third-party search and enable fast in-app question-answering for customers. They are cost-sensitive on high-volume embedding/reranking flows.
- Workshop findings: batching to 16 reduced effective per-token compute by ~24% in our sim; prefix-KV caching for repeated session queries can cut token consumption by ~18% for their support-agent flows.
- Quantization: Q4 profiles produced 8-12% latency reduction with negligible quality drop on reranking tests; still want an accuracy guardrail for top-k precision.
- POC ask: include sample unit-economic spreadsheet (drive link above) and Dedicated sizing options (burst buckets + predictable throughput).
- Quote from VP Product: "If we can get predictable cost and a simple migration path, Dedicated is worth committing to — but need Procurement sign-off on SLAs."
- Open items: security package (ISO27001 asked for but SOC2 baseline acceptable), data residency assurance for EU customers, SSO/SAML integration timeline.
- Next: Diego to share procurement calendar; Priya to deliver final POC cost model by 2026-03-12.
